status: tiers are a PLANNING table (October 20, 2026); two dealer lines are implemented as data and GameTested with the real Modern Life items; nothing here has been driven, ridden or sold by a person
disclaimer: What a vehicle or a boat costs, why, and how it is acquired (D-101). The prices are the model's, not a player's: price = the larger of 1.8 times the raw materials a player could gather and the active hours of a level-appropriate wage the tier is meant to take, checked by tests/test_vehicle_tiers.py and the economy model (scripts/economy_model.py). Run scripts/generate_vehicle_supply.py to regenerate the dealer lines (data/underground_city/regional_stock/vehicles/). FUEL, REPAIR AND INSURANCE ARE NOT IMPLEMENTED and nothing here claims them: a vehicle that needs fuel in survival has no supply of fuel in this project yet.

pricing_rule.note: The raw-materials value of a craftable item is its iron-ingot equivalent (an iron block is nine ingots, a nugget a ninth) times iron_value_credits, plus a stated allowance for the rest. A dealer never sells for less than 1.8 times that, so buying is never cheaper than making and making never earns more than the dealer charges.

tiers.title: Bicycle

materials.recipe: 1 iron ingot, 3 iron nuggets, 2 tires (4 black wool and a nugget each)

tiers.note: Human powered, needs no fuel. The first thing worth saving for after a backpack; makes the road between the cities a pleasant walk's worth faster.

tiers.title: Motorboat

materials.recipe: 3 iron blocks, 1 iron ingot, 1 redstone block, 1 glass pane

tiers.note: The short water crossing between Valewood and Blackwater (D-048) and a 27-slot hold (D-077 searches it). Sold in Valewood only, one at a time, and scarce; or crafted from about 28 iron. Whether it needs fuel was not audited and is not claimed.

tiers.title: Quad
tiers.note: PROPOSED price. Immersive Vehicles builds a vehicle at its own Vehicle Bench from parts that the pack defines; the bench recipe is vanilla (planks, a lectern, a writable book) but the vehicle's parts and their materials are inside the pack and were not priced in this pass. Not sold by a dealer. Needs fuel, which this project does not supply.

excluded.why: A three-city region is crossed in minutes on the ground (D-048); aircraft would remove the road, the checkpoint and the ferry. Three of these are military (an attack helicopter, a bomber, a fighter).
An armoured vehicle has no place in a living-world economy with a police force that has no answer to it.

The pack ships 24 gun-type parts (machine guns, turrets, bomb racks and rocket pods, but also spotlights and spray cans: ItemPartGun) and 24 kinds of bullet, bomb, rocket, flare and paint (ItemBullet). They are not blocked by this pass; whether the Vehicle Bench may build the weapons is an OPEN owner decision recorded in the roadmap.

audit.how: VehicleAuditGameTests prints the registry of the running mods; run with -PucPack=vehicles,boats. Immersive Vehicles registers every item of its packs in one builder class (mcinterface1201.BuilderItem); the wrapped object says what it is.
audit.note: The Automobile Pack registers its vehicles under the same mts namespace with an oamp. prefix; the namespace oamp itself holds no items.

dealer.why: Valewood is the farming city: the bicycle that gets a farmer to the other cities.
The same price in every city: location moves nothing here.
